seed_sources.title: Clinical Autonomic Dysfunction: Measurement, Indications, Therapies, and Outcomes
seed_sources.abstract: Comprehensive guide to non-invasive autonomic nervous system testing using independent parasympathetic and sympathetic (P&S) monitoring. Covers measurement protocols, clinical indications, therapeutic protocols, and longitudinal outcomes from 5,000-patient Chicago cohort.
key_claims: Independent measurement of parasympathetic (RFa) and sympathetic (LFa) activity is required for accurate ANS assessment.
LFa/RFa ratio between 0.4 and 3.0 defines the resting normal window; <0.4 is parasympathetic excess.
Six-phase test (Baseline, Deep Breathing, Recovery, Valsalva, Recovery, Stand) is the diagnostic standard.

seed_sources.title: Fatigue and Dysautonomia: A Hidden Connection
seed_sources.abstract: Connects chronic fatigue presentations to underlying autonomic dysfunction, with emphasis on parasympathetic excess as a precursor to chronic fatigue syndrome and fibromyalgia.
key_claims: Parasympathetic excess during physical challenge is the fingerprint of chronic vagal over-activation.
Most chronic-fatigue patients present autonomic dysfunction before any cardiac findings.

seed_sources.title: Long-COVID and the Autonomic Nervous System: The Journey to Dysautonomia
seed_sources.abstract: Documents the post-COVID dysautonomia phenotype — pre-clinical inflammation, autonomic neuropathy, POTS, and orthostatic intolerance — with P&S-guided treatment protocols.
key_claims: Post-viral dysautonomia presents as POTS, orthostatic intolerance, or parasympathetic excess depending on the inflammatory trajectory.
Early P&S monitoring identifies post-COVID autonomic injury before standard cardiology workup.

seed_sources.title: A Critical Analysis of Dysautonomia
seed_sources.abstract: Critical review of dysautonomia phenotypes (CAN, POTS, OD, VVS, OI, OH) with diagnostic thresholds and differential algorithms.
key_claims: Cardiovascular Autonomic Neuropathy (CAN) is defined by abnormal LFa, abnormal Ewing ratios, and abnormal orthostatic LFa response.
Vasovagal syncope presents with a flat 30:15 ratio and otherwise preserved sympathetic rise on stand.

seed_sources.title: Blood Pressure Variability and Autonomic Dysfunction
seed_sources.abstract: Relationship between BP variability (BPV) and autonomic dysfunction; BPV as an early warning signal for cardiovascular events.
key_claims: Elevated BPV correlates with autonomic neuropathy and predicts cardiovascular events independent of mean BP.
Combined P&S monitoring + BPV improves stratification of hypertensive patients.

seed_sources.title: Parasympathetic and Sympathetic Monitoring (P&S Monitoring) — Methodology
seed_sources.abstract: Foundational methodology paper defining the wavelet-based independent P&S monitoring approach using the patient's fundamental respiratory frequency.
key_claims: Using the patient's respiratory frequency as the RFa center (vs fixed 0.15–0.4 Hz HF band) yields valid measurements outside normal breathing ranges (athletes, COPD, panic disorder).
Morlet wavelet decomposition with 5-cycle window updated every 4 seconds is the spectral standard.

seed_sources.title: Age-Continuous Normative Bands for HRV/LFa/RFa
seed_sources.abstract: Aggregated normal values for HRV-derived autonomic indices across age, sex, and BMI.
key_claims: RFa and LFa decline with age following a continuous P10/P90 envelope; tables form the basis for Colombo's age bands.

seed_sources.title: Normative Heart Rate Variability — Gelber Aggregated Curves
seed_sources.abstract: Aggregated normative HRV values used alongside Agelink to define Colombo P10/P90 age bands.
key_claims: HRV envelopes narrow with age and diabetes; used jointly with Agelink for Colombo age bands.

seed_sources.title: Ewing Autonomic Test Battery
seed_sources.abstract: Original autonomic test battery (E/I ratio, Valsalva ratio, 30:15 ratio, orthostatic BP, isometric handgrip) — bedrock of autonomic medicine.
key_claims: Composite Ewing battery is the time-domain reference standard for cardiac autonomic neuropathy (CAN).

seed_sources.title: Alpha-Lipoic Acid Neuroprotection in Autonomic Neuropathy
seed_sources.abstract: ALA slows progression of autonomic neuropathy and helps restore autonomic balance.
key_claims: ALA 600 mg/d is a non-prescription antioxidant specific for nerves; slows ANS neuropathy progression.

seed_sources.title: ALA Blood Pressure Contraindication
seed_sources.abstract: Documents ALA contraindication in low baseline BP — risk of further hypotension.
key_claims: ALA is contraindicated when baseline systolic BP is low.

seed_sources.title: Heart Rate Variability — Standards of Measurement (Task Force)
seed_sources.authors: Task Force of the European Society of Cardiology and the North American Society of Pacing and Electrophysiology
seed_sources.abstract: International consensus standards for HRV measurement, time-domain and frequency-domain indices.
key_claims: RMSSD and SDNN are the time-domain HRV gold standards; LF/HF ratio reflects sympathovagal balance with caveats.
